/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/haider-e-karraar.md\")
original = path.read_bytes()
metadata, roman_and_body = original.split(b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)
roman, body = roman_and_body.split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
lyrics = roman.decode()
for old, new, count in [
    (\"Ali Ali Maula Ali ya Ali ya Ali\", \"Ali Ali Maula Ali ya Ali\", 2),
    (\"Piroṅ meiṅ mera pir\", \"Piroṅ meiṅ pir\", 4),
    (\"Aap sardaar haiṅ Maula\", \"Aap sarkaar haiṅ Maula\", 1),
    (\"Ali un Waliullah\", \"Aliyyun Waliullah\", 4),
    (\"Hyder\", \"Haider\", 21),
    (\"Nuqta-e-baa-sharaf\", \"Nuqta-e-baa sharaf\", 1),
]:
    assert lyrics.count(old) == count, (old, lyrics.count(old))
    lyrics = lyrics.replace(old, new)

source_blocks = body.decode().strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
roman_blocks = lyrics.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
assert len(source_blocks) == len(roman_blocks) == 18
for number, (source, transliteration) in enumerate(zip(source_blocks, roman_blocks)):
    source_lines = source.splitlines()
    roman_lines = transliteration.strip().splitlines()
    assert len(source_lines) == len(roman_lines), number
    if number:
        assert source_lines[0].translate(str.maketrans(\"۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹\", \"0123456789\")) == roman_lines[0] == str(number)
assert all(character.isascii() or character in \"ṅṄ\" for character in lyrics)
path.write_bytes(metadata + b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + lyrics.encode() + b\"\\n---\\n\" + body)
PY"
